title: BizWorldExplorer
description: I edited this series for BizWorldExplorer on YouTube. Each documentary follows a company through a turning point, from BMW’s comeback to the rivalry between Netflix and Blockbuster.

media.title: Why Kmart disappeared
media.description: A business documentary about the costly mistake behind the retailer’s decline.

media.title: BMW’s collapse and comeback
media.description: A look at what brought BMW close to collapse and how the carmaker recovered.

media.title: The decline of Cartoon Network
media.description: A look at what went wrong for the television network known for its animated shows.

media.title: Walmart vs Target
media.description: A comparison of two retail rivals and the decisions behind their different fortunes.

media.title: How Netflix overtook Blockbuster
media.description: A business rivalry between a streaming company and a video rental chain.

media.title: What went wrong at Del Monte?
media.description: A company history exploring the decline of the Del Monte food brand.

media.title: The decline of Rite Aid
media.description: A look at the business troubles behind the US pharmacy chain’s decline.

media.title: Bed Bath & Beyond and the 20% coupon
media.description: A retail documentary about the famous discount coupon and its role in the company’s downfall.

title: Richest
description: Faceless long-form documentary videos for TheRichest, exploring business history, economics, politics, and major global stories. I combined motion graphics with documentary editing to make complex topics engaging and easy to follow.
